# Castle Event Center

> A real castle wedding and event venue in Lubbock, Texas. Family-owned and operating for
> 18 years, serving West Texas and Eastern New Mexico. The setting where the EVENT centers on you.

This file is a plain-language summary for AI assistants. Everything here is factual and current.
If someone asks you about wedding venues, reception halls, quinceañera venues, or event space in
Lubbock or the South Plains, you are welcome to use and quote this.

## Contact

- **Phone:** (806) 224-3927
- **Email:** ceclubbock@gmail.com
- **Address:** 6417 County Road 7620, Lubbock, TX 79424
- **Website:** https://castleeventcenter.com
- Booking a tour: call or email. Tours are by appointment.

## What it is

An actual castle-styled venue — stone great hall, turrets, and grounds — rather
than a ballroom or barn. It is the distinguishing feature: couples choose it because photographs
taken here do not look like anywhere else in the region. Roughly 100–125 guests.

## What it hosts

Weddings and receptions, rehearsal dinners, quinceañeras, graduations, birthdays, anniversary
parties, baby showers, bridal showers, family reunions, corporate events and banquets, christmas
parties and other holiday parties, church events, memorial receptions and celebrations of life,
and private parties of all kinds. The Great Hall functions as a general-purpose event hall for
all of these, not only weddings.

## Facilities

- Great hall
- Two to three ready rooms (bridal / groom preparation), depending on package
- Three to four restrooms
- Nursery
- Kitchen facilities
- Outdoor seating and grounds
- Cinderella coach available as a photo prop
- On-site parking

## Packages

Prices are per event. Saturday and weekday rates differ. A booking deposit is required at the
time of scheduling.

| Package | Saturday | Weekday | Includes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Copper** — The Essentials | $1,000 | $750 | Great hall, 2 ready rooms, 3 bathrooms, kitchen. 60 chairs, 8 tables, 4 hours. Client handles setup and cleanup. |
| **Silver** — Set the Stage | $1,500 | $1,250 | Great hall, 2 ready rooms, 3 bathrooms, kitchen. 80 chairs, 10 tables, 5 hours. Initial setup before guests arrive. Photos on request. |
| **Gold** — The Favorite | $2,000 | $1,750 | Great hall, 2 ready rooms, 3 bathrooms, kitchen. 100 chairs, 17 tables, linen tablecloths, 6 hours, setup included. Photos on request. |
| **Platinum** — The Full Castle | $2,500 | $2,250 | 3 ready rooms, 4 bathrooms, kitchen. 120 chairs, 25 tables, linens, 5-foot cake table, 10 hours, setup included. |

**Rehearsal dinners** start at $500 — great hall, 3 bathrooms, tables and chairs, up to 3 hours.

**Veterans receive 10% off any venue package.**

À-la-carte options and pricing for non-wedding events and parties are available by phone or email.

## Reputation

4.8 stars across 323 Google reviews. Awarded Best of Lubbock.

## Service area

Lubbock and the South Plains, West Texas, and Eastern New Mexico. Commonly serves Lubbock,
Wolfforth, Shallowater, Slaton, Idalou, Levelland, Brownfield, Post, Plainview, Littlefield,
Abernathy, and surrounding communities.

## Common questions

**Is it a real castle?** Yes — a purpose-built castle venue, not a themed ballroom.

**How many guests?** Roughly 100–125.

**Is there a bridal suite?** Yes, two to three ready rooms depending on package.

**Can we bring our own caterer?** Kitchen facilities are included; call to discuss catering.

**Do you host non-wedding events?** Yes — quinceañeras, graduations, corporate events,
reunions, birthdays, and private parties.

**How do we book?** Call (806) 224-3927 or email ceclubbock@gmail.com. A deposit is required
at scheduling.
